basic_details.job_title: ILBS Project research Scientist III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Two contract posts are open on a 3-year project funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) at the Institute of Liver & Biliary Sciences (ILBS), New Delhi: one Project research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) at Rs.78000/- +30% HRA and one Project research Scientist-1 (non-medical) at Rs.56000/- +30% HRA. Both posts ask for a post graduate degree, with further conditions for each post. Applicants must email their resume by 18 November 2026, and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview/skill test on 21 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Interested candidates who meet the eligibility criteria may send their resume to Mr. Rahul by email at [email protected], with a copy (cc) to Dr. Anupam Kumar at [email protected], by 18 November 2026. Dr. Anupam Kumar is Additional Professor (Molecular and Cellular Medicine), Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences (ILBS), Vasant Kunj, New Delhi- 110070. An email subject line is not specified in the notice.
With the application: resume, sent by email
For shortlisted candidates: photocopies of all degree/certificate/diploma/testimonials
For shortlisted candidates: printed application form (where to get this form is not specified in the notice)
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided. For any query, call the Department of Molecular and Cellular Medicine on telephone No. 011-46300000 Ext: 24165. The ILBS letterhead also prints Tel.: 26706700, 46300000 and Fax: 26123504.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Targeting Bone marrow Myelopoiesis to Restore Macrophage-Mediated Liver Repair in MASH-related Cirrhosis
Project duration: 3 years. Appointment: contract basis for 12 months initially.
Project research Scientist-III (Non-Medical); Project research Scientist-1 (non-medical)
Total Rs.101400/- pm for Scientist-III; total Rs.72800/- pm for Scientist-1 (both including 30% HRA)

content_sections.heading: About ILBS
content_sections.text: The Institute of Liver & Biliary Sciences is an autonomous society under the GNCT of Delhi, located at D-1, Vasantkunj, New Delhi -110070 (India). These two posts are part of an ICMR-funded project on bone marrow myelopoiesis and macrophage-mediated liver repair in MASH-related cirrhosis. The official website printed on the notice is www.ilbs.in .

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: ILBS has advertised 2 posts in total, one opening for each position.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives each post its own essential qualification, desirable experience and age limit. Each post has two numbered essential lines, shown below as printed. The cut-off date for counting age and any age relaxation are not specified in the notice. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: 1. First class post graduate degree, including the integrated PG degree with three years of experience or PhD. 2. Second class post graduate degree, including the integrated PG degree with PhD and 3 years of experience.
rows.desirable: Should have experience in animal experiment, cell culture, Omics analysis Singal cell sequencing

rows.essential_qualification: 1. First class post graduate degree, including the integrated PG degree. 2. Second class post graduate degree, including the integrated PG degree with PhD.
rows.desirable: Should have experience in animal experiment, cell culture, FACS

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment under the project shall be on contract basis for 12 months initially and will be extended on the basis of performance. The project itself has a duration of 3 years. The monthly totals printed for both posts already include the 30% HRA.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ILBS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Interested candidates who meet the eligibility criteria may send their resume to Mr. Rahul by email at [email protected] , with a copy (cc) to Dr. Anupam Kumar at [email protected] , by 18 November 2026. Dr. Anupam Kumar is Additional Professor (Molecular and Cellular Medicine), Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences (ILBS), Vasant Kunj, New Delhi- 110070. An email subject line is not specified in the notice. With the application: resume, sent by email For shortlisted candidates: photocopies of all degree/certificate/diploma/testimonials For shortlisted candidates: printed application form (where to get this form is not specified in the notice)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview/skill test, to be held in the Institute on Saturday, 21 November 2026. The notice does not describe the shortlisting criteria or say how the interview/skill test will be marked.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Project research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) and one Project research Scientist-1 (non-medical).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The resume must be sent by email by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for these ILBS posts?
faq.answer: Both posts require a first class or second class post graduate degree, including the integrated PG degree. The experience and PhD conditions differ by post and class of degree, as shown in the Who Can Apply table.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for Project research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) and 35 years for Project research Scientist-1 (non-medical).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Project research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) gets Rs.78000/- +30% HRA, total Rs.101400/- pm. Project research Scientist-1 (non-medical) gets Rs.56000/- +30% HRA, total Rs.72800/- pm.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay, and is TA/DA given?
faq.answer: Yes, 30% HRA is paid on top of the pay and is included in the printed monthly totals. No TA/DA will be provided.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for ILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email your resume to Mr. Rahul at [email protected] and mark a copy to Dr. Anupam Kumar at [email protected] by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview/skill test, which will be held in the Institute on Saturday, 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Are these jobs permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: They are contract appointments under the project, for 12 months initially, and will be extended on the basis of performance. The project duration is 3 years.
